context: This evaluates the ability to use superagent's get() method to perform basic HTTP GET requests and handle the response data.

checklist.name: Import superagent
checklist.description: Correctly imports or requires the superagent library

checklist.name: Use get() method
checklist.description: Uses superagent's get() method or request.get() to make the HTTP request

checklist.name: URL construction
checklist.description: Properly constructs the URL with the user ID parameter

checklist.name: Promise handling
checklist.description: Correctly uses then() or async/await to handle the promise returned by superagent

checklist.name: Response body access
checklist.description: Accesses the response body using the .body property or equivalent
